text: World that is in rebellion against God. In the evil of this world brings pain to us and can cause us to have anger, and oftentimes that anger is a righteous anger. And we ask, like people in Revelation ask, "How long, O Lord, will this last? How long will it seem that Babylon is victorious?" The Psalmist right here in Psalm one thirty seven is asking, "How long?" The Psalmist in the Psalms multiple times, "How long, O Lord? How long is this world going to be crooked and bit out of shape? How long is it going to seem like evil wins
